title: Lido · Validator fleet
description: Three Nimbus validator instances with shared main and fallback Nethermind or Geth execution clients and Nimbus beacon nodes. Loaded keys and successful submissions are distinguished from on-chain state. See monitoring/README.md for metric semantics and deployment.

list.name: validator
list.label: Validator clients
list.query: VC 1 : validator-1, VC 2 : validator-2, VC 3 : validator-3

panels.title: Loaded validators
panels.description: Loaded keys, not the on-chain active count. Suppressed if any selected validator endpoint or its count metric is missing, rather than displaying a misleading partial total.

targets.expr: sum((validators{job="validator",host=~"${validator:regex}"} and on(job, instance) (up{job="validator",host=~"${validator:regex}"} == 1))) and on() (count((validators{job="validator",host=~"${validator:regex}"} and on(job, instance) (up{job="validator",host=~"${validator:regex}"} == 1))) == count(up{job="validator",host=~"${validator:regex}"}))

panels.title: Activity totals
panels.description: Estimated successful submissions over the selected dashboard time range. Calculated from the validator client only, so shared beacon nodes are not counted again. Counter resets are handled; scrape outages and history before this Prometheus started can make totals incomplete. Submission is not proof of on-chain inclusion.

panels.title: Metrics reporting
panels.description: Reporting now: fraction of selected validator metric endpoints currently reachable. Scrape history: the lowest collection availability among selected instances over the time range, for observed samples only. Neither measures duty success.

panels.title: Attestations · per 45 s
panels.description: Uses the supplied Rocket Pool activity panel’s Nimbus calculation: rate(counter[$__rate_interval]) × 45. Values are average successful submissions per 45 seconds, not counts in fixed 45-second buckets. Grafana automatically chooses the averaging window from chart resolution and scrape interval. Counter resets are handled before aggregation. One series per validator instance. The attestation axis starts at zero with a soft upper bound of 5; it expands automatically for higher activity.

panels.title: Proposals · rolling 5m
panels.description: Whole-number estimates of successful proposal submissions during the preceding five minutes: round(sum(increase(counter[5m]))). Handles observed counter resets. These are rolling windows, so adjacent points can include the same proposal; do not sum plotted points. Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes, so this is not an exact event log. Missing metrics remain No data.

panels.title: Accuracy · $accuracy_window
panels.description: Attestation source/target/head correctness for each selected beacon node’s monitored validators. Main and fallback are independent series, never blended. Solid lines = main; dashed lines = fallback. This is an indication of your validator performance, not a network-wide health measurement. Zero opportunities, offline servers and missing metrics remain No data.

targets.expr: (sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_source_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) / (sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_source_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_source_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])))) and on(host) ((sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_source_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_source_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window]))) > 0) and on(host) (min by(host) (up{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) == 1)

(sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_target_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) / (sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_target_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_target_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])))) and on(host) ((sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_target_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_target_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window]))) > 0) and on(host) (min by(host) (up{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) == 1)

(sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) / (sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])))) and on(host) ((sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window]))) > 0) and on(host) (min by(host) (up{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) == 1)

panels.title: Validator clients · activity totals for selected period
panels.description: Compare all selected validator clients. Metrics Up means the endpoint responds, not proof of successful duties. Loaded keys are attached keys, not on-chain active count. Attestations/proposals are successful submissions over the selected time range. Good links counts Nimbus endpoints classified good; it does not identify which backend is active. Missing values remain blank (—). Expand client details below for history and other connection states.

panels.title: Shared servers · execution and consensus
panels.description: Main and fallback are shown independently. EC = Nethermind or Geth; CL = Nimbus beacon node. Head accuracy uses the selected accuracy window and each beacon node’s monitored validator set. It is not per-validator-instance accuracy. Expand server details for source/target/head accuracy histories, chain heads and monitor count. RAM is process memory; Geth process RAM is unavailable without a verified process-memory metric (system_memory_* is not substituted); Host RAM and CPU are machine percentages.

targets.expr: max by(host) (((ethereum_peer_count{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} or on(job, instance) p2p_peers{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} == 1)))

(sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) / (sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])))) and on(host) ((sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_hit_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window])) + sum by(host) (increase(validator_monitor_prev_epoch_on_chain_head_attester_miss_total{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}",validator="total"}[$accuracy_window]))) > 0) and on(host) (min by(host) (up{job="eth2",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) == 1)

panels.title: Validator client
panels.description: Metrics Up means this endpoint is reachable, not proof of successful duties. Loaded keys are attached validators, not an on-chain active count.

panels.title: Activity · selected period
panels.description: Estimated successful submissions over the selected dashboard time range. Calculated from the validator client only, so shared beacon nodes are not counted again. Counter resets are handled; scrape outages and history before this Prometheus started can make totals incomplete. Submission is not proof of on-chain inclusion.

panels.title: VC RAM
panels.description: Nimbus validator process resident memory on this instance. Beacon and execution client memory is shown under shared servers.

panels.title: Host resources
panels.description: CPU utilization and memory consumption of this validator machine. These are host percentages; validator process RAM is shown separately.

panels.title: Beacon links
panels.description: Nimbus reports counts, not endpoint identity. good: usable for all requests; viable: usable for some requests; bad: unusable. With two configured backends, two good connections indicates full observed redundancy. This does not identify which server handled a particular request.

panels.title: Validator activity
panels.description: Attestations: average submissions per 45 seconds (left axis, RP rate formula). Proposals: whole-number rolling five-minute estimates (right axis). Whole-number estimates of successful proposal submissions during the preceding five minutes: round(sum(increase(counter[5m]))). Handles observed counter resets. These are rolling windows, so adjacent points can include the same proposal; do not sum plotted points. Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes, so this is not an exact event log. Missing metrics remain No data.

panels.title: Host CPU / RAM
panels.description: CPU and RAM usage as percentages of this validator host. Both share the percentage axis; process memory in bytes is shown separately.

panels.title: Beacon connection history
panels.description: Nimbus reports counts, not endpoint identity. good: usable for all requests; viable: usable for some requests; bad: unusable. With two configured backends, two good connections indicates full observed redundancy. This does not identify which server handled a particular request.

panels.title: Metrics
panels.description: Reachability of execution, consensus and host metric endpoints from the hub. Up does not establish sync or readiness.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Execution and consensus peer counts. Separate networks, not a combined total.

targets.expr: ((ethereum_peer_count{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} or on(job, instance) p2p_peers{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Client RAM
panels.description: Execution client working-set bytes and consensus client resident memory, displayed separately. These processes run on this shared server, not on a validator instance. Geth process RAM is unavailable until a verified process-memory metric is provided; system_memory_* is not substituted for process RAM.

panels.title: Host resources
panels.description: CPU utilization and RAM consumption of this shared server.

panels.title: Chain / validator monitor
panels.description: Full beacon head slot and execution head block numbers. These use different counters and are not summed. Compare each with the corresponding main/fallback value. Monitored validators are the set observed by this beacon node, not an authoritative fleet key count.

targets.expr: ((nethermind_blockchain_height{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} or on(job, instance) chain_head_block{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Accuracy · $accuracy_window
panels.description: Observed accuracy for the validators monitored by THIS beacon node. Uses aggregate validator="total" metrics and a window long enough for epoch updates. Main and fallback observations are never summed. The two servers may monitor different sets as duties fail over. Zero opportunities or missing monitoring metrics are No data, not 100%. This is not a per-validator-instance attribution.

targets.expr: ((ethereum_peer_count{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} or on(job, instance) p2p_peers{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eth1",host=~"${backend:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Client RAM history
panels.description: Geth process RAM is unavailable until a verified process-memory metric is provided; system_memory_* is not substituted for process RAM.

panels.title: Filesystem space used
panels.description: Filesystem capacity unavailable to ordinary users: 1 - available/size, including reserved space. Each host and mount is separate; root and data mounts such as /data are included. Temporary/container filesystems and zero-size filesystems are excluded. No data means missing metrics, not an empty disk. Requires a read-only host rootfs mount plus --path.rootfs on containerized node-exporter; see STORAGE.md.
